request.deadline: 9-month delivery period from July 2026 to March 2027
deliverables: Audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO threshold custody modes under controlled access
SPO and dApp partner pipeline required for public launch
Public rollout and 24 months of operations deferred to Phase 2
request.what: Phase 1 of 2 for Bifrost, a Bitcoin-Cardano bridge, to move from working testnet to launch readiness through hardening, security audits, formal verification, ecosystem and partner readiness, stewardship, and economic foundations.

claims.claim: Bifrost is designed as a permissionless Bitcoin-Cardano bridge secured by Cardano's SPO ecosystem that brings BTC onto Cardano as a native Cardano asset.
The proposal requests ₳12,332,031, stated as approximately $1,973,125 at 0.16 USD/ADA including a 10% refundable contingency, for a 9-month delivery period.
By the end of Phase 1, Bifrost will be an audited bridge running on Cardano mainnet in both federated and SPO-threshold custody modes under controlled access.
Bifrost's custody model distributes locked BTC across 400+ Cardano SPOs weighted by delegation, with movement requiring a cryptographic threshold representing the majority of delegated stake.
If SPO coordination fails, Bifrost uses a federated mode as an operational fallback for continuity.
Bifrost's smart contracts, off-chain tooling, and SDK are released under Apache 2.0 so anyone can audit, fork, run, or build on the bridge without permission.
Bifrost is currently funded through Catalyst Fund 14 for ₳739,000 and aims to prove the architecture end-to-end on Bitcoin Testnet4 and Cardano Preprod by August 2026.
The document states Catalyst milestones M1 and M2 are done and approved, while later milestone details are truncated in the supplied text.
The proposal targets 1,200 BTC TVL, about 600,000 annual transactions, and 3,000 fBTC-holding wallets by Q2 2029 as Bifrost contributions to Cardano 2030 KPIs.
The proposal states bridge fees in fBTC will fund operations and surplus will split to SPOs and the Cardano Treasury.

summary: The document requests ₳12,332,031 for Phase 1 launch-readiness work on Bifrost, a Bitcoin-to-Cardano bridge using SPO-threshold custody, native fBTC issuance, audits, formal verification, stewardship setup, and partner readiness before a later Phase 2 public rollout.
